summary: OVHcloud's AI Endpoints page advertises a limited 'Public Cloud Free Trial' special offer: US$200 in free credit for the first-time setup and use of a Public Cloud project, which can be spent on AI Endpoints (token-billed access to hosted AI models). New and existing customers qualify if they have never created a Public Cloud project. One voucher per person, for one project; once activated it is valid for one month or until the balance is used up. A valid payment method must be saved in the OVHcloud customer account. The voucher is non-exchangeable, non-refundable, and non-redeemable.
claim_steps: Create or sign in to an OVHcloud customer account and save a valid payment method
Create your first Public Cloud project to activate the US$200 Public Cloud Free Trial voucher
Use AI Endpoints from that project within one month of activation
